channel.title: Docker Compose on DefectDojo Documentation
channel.description: Recent content in Docker Compose on DefectDojo Documentation

item.title: Installing on Docker Compose
item.description: This page covers installing DefectDojo Pro on Docker Compose, which is the simpler of the two self-hosted models and the right choice if you are not already running Kubernetes.

item.title: DefectDojo Pro Upgrade Guide (Docker Compose)
item.description: This guide covers upgrading a self-hosted DefectDojo Pro deployment that runs on Docker Compose, managed with dojo-compose-cli. If you run on Kubernetes, see the DefectDojo Pro Upgrade Guide for the Helm chart instead.

item.title: Installing DefectDojo Pro in an Air-Gapped Environment
item.description: This page is a supplement to the installation instructions supplied with your DefectDojo Pro license. It covers only what changes when the target host has no route to the internet. Everything else, including the host prerequisites and the PostgreSQL setup, follows the standard instructions.

item.title: Adding Storage for Uploaded Files
item.description: Uploaded files live in the media directory on the host, and on a Docker Compose deployment the space available for them is whatever the VM’s disk has left. Large uploads such as SBOMs can fill that disk. This page covers expanding the space without changing the deployment itself.

item.title: Upload Size Limits for Large Scan Files
item.description: A large scan file can be rejected at two points on a Docker Compose deployment: the application’s own limit, and the nginx that ships in front of it. The error you get tells you which one you hit. Running Kubernetes? See Upload Size Limits for Large Scan Files for the Helm chart, which adds ingress and import-route limits that do not apply here.
